issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction, and a licensed form exists under either attachment — `(Location sk_hunt_1 harbor_row)` on the event, or `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` on the crowd, since 'at' is in LocatedIn's containment list — yet the parse emits neither, so the crowd's position reaches the KB nowhere (the gather event's own Location does not attach to the crowd).

The half that stands is that the locative is again unrecorded; the half that is overstated is 'a second time' — the NP is an anaphoric definite already resolved to sk_crowd_1, so this restates the same fact as issue 0 and one `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` atom discharges both clauses, and its absence here widens no claim on its own.

Names and casing mandates the type atom when the kind word sits inside the name — 'the Kestrel River' → `(Member kestrel_river river)` beside the Name — so `(Member harbor_station station)` and `(Member harbor_row row)` are licensed and required, and omitting them leaves both named places untyped.

'Left silken threads on the lantern' deposits the threads without altering them, which is the Theme side of the 'does the object itself change?' test (and the unclear-case default is Theme anyway), so `(Patient sk_leave_1 sk_silken_threads_1)` asserts a change the sentence does not state, in the flat atom and in the per-member rule alike.

gaps_confirmed: verb/noun homonymy survives lemmatization: the lighting event class `(Member sk_light_1 light)` and the illumination kind `(Inheritance mist_light light)` collapse onto one symbol `light`, and the instruction set supplies no sense index or other disambiguating mechanism
new_gaps: a bare MASS subject of an episodic clause ('Mire-essence formed in a cauldron by evening') has no stated routing: the episodic bare-plural rule mints a group witness, but a mass has no members, so nothing says whether it takes a witness or the bare class constant — here the same substance ends up under two symbols in one parse, the witness `sk_mire_essence_1` as subject and the bare constant `mire_essence` as the burn event's object, with no link between them
defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form is the stated locative carried as `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` on the crowd (the reading the following sentence's identical NP selects), or `(Location sk_hunt_1 harbor_row)` if the PP is read as an event adjunct. Issue 2: the compliant form adds `(Member harbor_station station)` and `(Member harbor_row row)` beside the existing Name atoms. Issue 3: the compliant form is `(Theme sk_leave_1 sk_silken_threads_1)`, with the same substitution inside the per-member rule at index 66.
notes: The per-member rules copy the shared object into each member's event, which is exactly the prescribed 'Three students passed the exam' shape and not a defect. Item aside from the four issues, the roles, the group/count encoding, the 'by evening' TimeAtMost and the participial 'stored' all follow the instruction set.
